name: al-agentic-dev
description: Composable AL/Business Central agentic skills: /al-steer, /al-grill-adr, /al-event-model, /al-design, /al-scope, /al-refine, /al-implement, /al-refactor, /al-mutate, /al-code-review, /al-research, /al-second-opinion. Two persistence layers: repo-root markdown (CONTEXT.md, docs/adr/, .out-of-scope/) and branch-scoped HTML specs (event-model.html + architecture.html + tasks.html). SKILLs express intent and rationale; the agent shapes output per situation. NEW in 0.26.0: /al-research drops the `recent features` carve-out (single source is a draft, two families is verification); six callers (/al-implement, /al-refine, /al-design, /al-grill-adr, /al-event-model, /al-refactor) now bind `pointed at in the workspace` to a real `al-symbols-mcp` or `grep` lookup this session, and the citation-chain question is hoisted into each SKILL's first-read bullet list. Addresses agents skipping /al-research entirely and shipping single-source findings when invoked.
